name: Thia Aide Comment Moderator
author: thiaide

sections.description:
Thia Aide Comment Moderator connects your WordPress site to the Thia Aide AI API to analyze comments before they are published. It helps reduce spam and toxic comments without requiring manual approval.

Features:

  • Real-time AI comment analysis
  • Blocks offensive language, threats, and spam
  • Admin panel to manage blocked IPs and Users
  • Statistics dashboard for API usage
  • Warning system for repeat offenders
  • Fully translatable

Privacy Notice:

This plugin sends comment content, author name, and IP address to the Thia Aide API (thiaide.com) for moderation purposes. IP addresses and email addresses of blocked users are stored locally in your WordPress database. Please ensure this complies with your local privacy laws and update your privacy policy accordingly.

External services

This plugin connects to the Thia Aide API (https://thiaide.com/api/) to analyze comments for moderation purposes.

It sends the comment content, author name, and IP address to the API when:
– A new comment is submitted for moderation
– A comment is checked via AJAX before submission
– An API key is validated in the admin settings

This service is provided by Thia Aide:
– Terms of Use: https://www.thiaide.com/terms-of-use/
– Privacy Policy: https://www.thiaide.com/privacy-policy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/thia-aide-comment-moderator directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to ‘Thia Moderator’ menu and enter your API key from Thia Aide.
sections.faq:
Where do I get an API key?

Visit Thia Aide to register and generate an API key.

Does this plugin work with caching plugins?

Yes, it hooks into WordPress core comment functions and works alongside most caching solutions.

Can I customize the moderation rules?

Moderation rules are managed through the AI prompt configuration. Contact Thia Aide support for custom rule sets.
